august 16, 2019: the title track of lover arrived a week ahead of the album — a waltz she wrote alone, late, at the piano. her pitch for the sound: the last two people on a dance floor at 3 a.m., swaying. it took about six hours to record.

why: Calendar slot 2026-08-16 15:00Z X, heartbeat:on-this-day, hook "the date" — a genuine dated Vault match, so the calendar’s symbol-thread fallback is not needed. Source: the Vault Lover item "Lover, the waltz she wrote alone" (2019-08-16, sourced Wikipedia + Rolling Stone): written solo late at the piano, released a week before the album as its third single, recorded with Jack Antonoff at Electric Lady in about six hours, and her own pitch for the sound — "just the last two people on a dance floor at 3 a.m. swaying". Second Lover post in the window (08-13 ran Cruel Summer); different pillar and subject, three days apart.
